mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) signals an easing monetary policy, which leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS is negative are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS > 5.0% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.5 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (measured as the 3-month change) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where the 3-month change in UNRATE is positive are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1600 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods where HOUST < 1600 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 and retail sales (RSAFS) falls below 670000, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where INDPRO < 100.0 and RSAFS < 670000 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO < 100.5), a decline in industrial production (measured as the 3-month change) signals worsening economic outlook, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods where INDPRO < 100.5 and the 3-month change in INDPRO is negative are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
